items.title: Afghan pushback survivor fights ‘impossible’ evidence rules in European courts with new UN case against Greece
items.summary: The EU's human rights court rejected a case from an Afghan pushback survivor who was just 15 years old when he was turned back to Turkey by the Hellenic coast guard. The impossibility of achieving justice on the systematic practice against migrants of all ages was highlighted by the European court's inadmission, as the young survivor was forced to appeal to the UN's human rights courts instead.
